biography:
I am currently completing my Bachelor's in Information Technology while developing practical skills in Machine Learning, Data Engineering, and AI research.

My work focuses on building explainable decision-support systems using reliable data rather than black-box solutions.

I enjoy solving complex real-world problems. Alongside my work in AI and machine learning, I am developing research interests in optimization, operations research and quantitative finance.
